classification.method: curated narrative classification based on meaningful work, visible contribution, human-impact measurement, verifiable institutional learning, open-source reuse and local-to-global experimentation
classification.note: HUMAN remains primary because the narrative evaluates technology and work by their effect on human life, meaning, development and dignity. LIGHT is substantial because contribution, authority, outcomes, success and failure must remain verifiable. DARK represents experimentation, uncertainty, open-source adaptation and the possibility of scaling a local prototype from Harran to Sanliurfa, Türkiye and beyond.

coverage_audit.critical_question: How can a human-centered system measure contribution without turning the human being into the object of continuous measurement?
